items.title: Consideration and Approval of a Motion to Levy the Maintenance and Operations ("M&O") Component of the Ad Valorem Tax Rate for Tax Year 2026
items.description: That the Board of Trustees approve the M&O portion of the property tax rate to be increased by the adoption of a tax rate of $0.0839 per $100 of assessed valuation, which is effectively a 7.98 percent increase in the tax rate.

items.description: That the Board of Trustees approve the I&S portion of the property tax rate of $0.0219 per $100 of taxable assessed valuation for Tax Year 2026.
